The demand for alternative energy sources is driven by increasing fuel costs and the 
 exponentially increasing need for electricity. The world simply cannot build power plants 
 quickly enough to meet the growing energy demands. 
 
To meet this demand Levitate has created a revolutionary ultra high efficiency hybrid Wind 
 and Solar solution that incorporates over 24 years of private research and development. 
 This unique alternative energy product is designed and manufactured in the United States 
 for use in municipalities, commercial rooftops, resort developments, college campuses, 
 rural communities, wind farms, and emergency/disaster recovery situations.
